brief: Add a live notifications feature. Mount a notification bell in the header area that polls api.js's fetchNotifications() every 5 seconds while store.state.settings.liveUpdates is true, writes results into store via store.set({notifications}), shows an unread-count badge, and renders a dropdown list. Respect the existing store subscription pattern. Return a single ES module 'feature.js' that imports from ./store.js and ./api.js and exports mountFeature(asideEl, mainEl).

Add infinite scrolling to the main item list. When the user scrolls near the bottom of the page, call api.js's fetchItems(nextCursor) and append the new items into store.state.items via store.set(...). Keep using the existing mountList rendering. Return a single ES module 'feature.js' that imports from ./store.js and ./api.js and exports mountFeature(asideEl, mainEl).

Add a feature that ensures every dynamically added card in the main section always carries the correct theme classes. Because feature widgets inject DOM after load, watch the main section with a MutationObserver and, for any newly added element, apply the current theme (read from theme.js's currentTheme()) by adding the matching CSS classes/variables. Return a single ES module 'feature.js' that imports from ./theme.js and exports mountFeature(asideEl, mainEl).

Add a 'compact mode' quick toggle in the aside that stays in sync with the Settings panel. When toggled it should call store.setSetting('density', ...) and dispatch a 'density:changed' event; it must also update itself when the density changes elsewhere (listen for store updates or the event). Reflect density on document.body's data-density attribute. Return a single ES module 'feature.js' that imports from ./store.js and exports mountFeature(asideEl, mainEl).

Add a live metrics strip to the main section: poll api.js's fetchMetrics() every second (only while settings.liveUpdates is on), render four metric chips, and keep the chips themed when the theme changes by reacting to theme.js's 'theme:changed' event. Return a single ES module 'feature.js' that imports from ./api.js and ./store.js and exports mountFeature(asideEl, mainEl).

Add an account form to the aside that autosaves: any change to name/email/notification fields calls api.js's saveSettings(), updates the store, and dispatches a 'settings:changed' event so the header live-preview updates. The header already listens to store updates, so avoid feedback when syncing back. Return a single ES module 'feature.js' that imports from ./store.js and ./api.js and exports mountFeature(asideEl, mainEl).

Add a collapsible folder tree to the aside that renders store.state.items as a nested hierarchy (group items by id ranges into nested folders) with unlimited nesting depth, expand/collapse, and a count badge per folder. Return a single ES module 'feature.js' that imports from ./store.js and exports mountFeature(asideEl, mainEl).

Add an activity ticker to the main section that auto-scrolls a vertical list of recent events upward continuously, fetching more events from api.js's fetchNotifications() when it nears the end, and pausing on hover. Return a single ES module 'feature.js' that imports from ./store.js and ./api.js and exports mountFeature(asideEl, mainEl).

Add a 'density observer' utility plus a search box. The search box filters the visible item list as the user types and dispatches an 'input' event for analytics; additionally, watch the list with a MutationObserver so that whenever rows are added/removed the empty-state message and result count are kept accurate. Return a single ES module 'feature.js' that imports from ./store.js and exports mountFeature(asideEl, mainEl).

Add a session keep-alive + toast system: every 30 seconds ping api.js's saveSettings() to keep the session warm, and provide a toast queue (exported showToast(msg)) that displays queued messages one at a time, each auto-dismissing after 4 seconds before showing the next. Return a single ES module 'feature.js' that imports from ./api.js and exports mountFeature(asideEl, mainEl) and showToast().
